text:
olivia: Heads-up — deploybot paused the promo. Staging canaries failed on artifact uploads, we hit sustained slow writes into the shared cache/mirror and multipart uploads timed out.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused (reason: artifact_stream_backpressure).
logs:
```
upload error: write timeout after 30s
mirror: 503 slow down
cache: mru eviction spike, write queue growing
```

sam: Saw similar in a staging run earlier today. Cache shard was draining slowly, causing uploader backpressure. Could try reducing multipart concurrency or route to eu-west backup registry.

maria: Given change window in ~40m, my vote is to pin to the last-good image and rerun CI after ops investigates. Avoids rollback during the window.

olivia: Agree. Pin to last-good sha and add a release note explaining the manual pin. I'll hold the decision for 10m to see if ops has a quick mitigation.

sam: Opened a promo pin PR: https://deploybot/internal/pins/2799999999 — pinned to sha256:fa3b7c9d. Added note: "manual pin due to upload backpressure and cache eviction spike". Also lowered uploader concurrency to 4 for the rerun.

ci-orchestrator-bot: Rerun queued on pinned image, pipeline #4821 (staged).

deploy-bot: Manual promotion locked until unpin command is issued. :lock:

maria: Ops to investigate cache eviction/TTL aggressive behavior (focused on MRU threshold). If they can warm a shard or increase drain rate, we can unpin and promote within the window.

olivia: Thanks — I'll update the release notes and mark the cut as "held - pinned". If ops finds a quick config fix, call for unpin; otherwise we'll reschedule promo to next window.

sam: Adding a short postmortem checklist in the ticket: collect uploader logs, cache shard metrics, multipart latency traces.

maria: Noted. Tagging infra oncall to look at shard drain: @infra-oncall.

olivia: Closing loop here — pinned and blocked promo. Will post status updates in #release-updates.
